2026So Far: Six for Six, and the Favorite Gets Back UpIn progress · 6 weeks in · Birdgangflyeagles 11-1, dahlilama 9-3, Goldminers1 7-5

Six weeks in, Birdgangflyeagles is still perfect head-to-head and has matched the best streak of his career. dahlilama stopped the bleeding, Goldminers1 hit a wall, and Bjspjs4 won a game nobody will frame. The evidence so far.

11-1Birdgangflyeagles, 6-0 head-to-head
124.00kevinnguu, top score of Week 6
780points for Goldminers1, league lead
143transactions so far

Six for six

Birdgangflyeagles beat giJ03 112.30–87.66 and is now 6-0 head-to-head and 11-1 overall. That's six straight wins, tying his own career-best streak from 2023. One more and it's a personal record. Last year he went 3-11 with a nine-game losing streak. This year his only loss is still to the league median. The jury has stopped laughing.

dahlilama files his appeal, and wins it

After two straight head-to-head losses while scoring 125-plus, dahlilama beat elysianbeer 106.12–93.08. It was above the week's median, so it counts twice: he's 9-3, alone in second. He's also second in points (763) and still the futures favorite at +250.

Goldminers1 hits a wall

juleon8 beat Goldminers1 115.98–96.56, ending Goldminers1's three-game head-to-head run. 96.56 was below the median, so it was a two-loss week and he's down to 7-5. He still leads the league with 780 points, 17 ahead of dahlilama. juleon8 is 7-5 too, and still has the fewest points against in the league (548).

The ugliest win in years

Bjspjs4 beat MayockJr 76.92–73.04. That 76.92 is the second-lowest winning score in league history, and the 149.96 combined is the fourth-fewest ever. A win is a win: it snapped his three-game head-to-head skid and he's 5-7. He also made his fifth trade of the season, sending Dameon Pierce to kevinnguu. Nobody else has more than one. MayockJr's 73.04 was the week's low score.

Also in the file

  • kevinnguu put up the week's top score, 124.00–91.98 over showmeyourtd23, for three straight head-to-head wins. The rookie is 7-5, tied with Goldminers1 and juleon8.
  • Sleon1000 finally got his first head-to-head win, 121.44–110.10 over rbanuelos3. He's 4-8 and still has the most points against in the league (746).
  • rbanuelos3 and elysianbeer have each lost two straight head-to-head and sit at 6-6.
  • MayockJr leads the league in moves with 29. showmeyourtd23 is 2-10, and last.

cases.dahlilama: 2023 champ, 2025 runner-up and Points King, 4-1 all-time in the playoffs. 9-3, and second in the league in points.
cases.Birdgangflyeagles: 11-1 and 6-0 head-to-head, tying his career-best six-game streak. Has been a 1 seed and a last-place team. No middle gear.
cases.rbanuelos3: Owns the season points record (1,858) and the highest score ever (180.24). Two playoff trips, no ring, and 6-6 after his 8-game head-to-head win streak ended in Week 3.
cases.juleon8: Owns the league-record 11-game head-to-head win streak, snapped by 1.82 points in Week 4. Went from 1-5 to the 3 seed last year.
cases.Sleon1000: Best all-time record (26-16) and two straight #1 seeds, but 0-2 in the playoffs and 4-8 this year.
cases.kevinnguu: Rookie. 122.86 in his debut, and his first head-to-head win came against the futures favorite.
cases.Goldminers1: Four seasons, no playoff trips yet, and a league-record 10 weekly low scores. Also leads the league in points after a 175.08 and a 144.32.
cases.elysianbeer: Dropped 152.58 in Week 4, the top score of that week. 6-6 after two straight head-to-head losses. Still paying off last October's trade.
cases.MayockJr: The league's busiest manager. 61 moves last year turned a 7-7 team into a third-place finish.
cases.giJ03: Rookie, 4-8, and his Week 2 55.74 is already on the all-time low-score list. The field.
cases.showmeyourtd23: Reached the first title game without making a trade. Hasn't made the playoffs since.
cases.Bjspjs4: 5-7 with five trades already, drafting from slot 8, the slot that's won all three titles. The 17-25 career mark is why the number's this long.
